official_sources.title: GDAL Geotransform Tutorial
official_sources.finding: The six-coefficient affine geotransform maps column/line to georeferenced coordinates, and the center of the upper-left pixel is at pixel/line 0.5,0.5.
official_sources.limitation: Formula correctness does not bind the target raster or parcel.

official_sources.title: GDALGeoTransform class reference
official_sources.finding: GDALGeoTransform exposes affine rotation/scale terms and an inverse transform that fails when the transform is not invertible.
official_sources.limitation: Runtime coefficients still require immutable target-raster capture.

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 33 PixelIsPoint interpretation
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF distinguishes RasterPixelIsArea and RasterPixelIsPoint; PixelIsPoint georeferencing changes the interpretation of sample location.
official_sources.limitation: The target GeoTIFF raster type must be read from the actual input.

official_sources.title: GDAL GeoTIFF driver
official_sources.finding: The GTiff driver documents PixelIsPoint handling and compatibility switches that can alter geotransform interpretation.
official_sources.limitation: Compatibility configuration must be frozen at runtime.

official_sources.title: GDAL Raster Data Model
official_sources.finding: Raster georeferencing may use affine transforms or GCPs; when both exist the data model does not define which is authoritative.
official_sources.limitation: The terminal workflow must explicitly record the selected georeferencing method.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info
official_sources.finding: pixel-info reports input coordinates, converted column/line, raw and unscaled values, and supports explicit position CRS and overview selection.
official_sources.limitation: Interpolation or overview selection produces non-native evidence unless explicitly prohibited.

official_sources.title: gdallocationinfo
official_sources.finding: gdallocationinfo supplies an independent coordinate-to-pixel query path with selectable CRS, overview and resampling.
official_sources.limitation: Independent query only helps if both tools use the same frozen input and native sampling policy.

official_sources.title: gdaltransform
official_sources.finding: gdaltransform can map between image pixel/line and georeferenced coordinates and exposes inverse transformation plus coordinate epochs.
official_sources.limitation: GCP/RPC/TPS modes must not silently replace the affine method.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info
official_sources.finding: raster-info reports raster size, CRS, geotransform, GCPs, datatype and NoData, providing a machine-readable preflight inventory.
official_sources.limitation: Reported metadata is preflight evidence, not parcel-specific execution.

official_sources.title: OGRCoordinateTransformationOptions
official_sources.finding: Coordinate transformation options expose area of interest, desired accuracy, ballpark rejection and only-best operation selection.
official_sources.limitation: The selected coordinate operation still must be logged and replayed.

official_sources.title: ogr2ogr transformation controls
official_sources.finding: ogr2ogr exposes source/target epochs, custom coordinate-operation pipelines, ONLY_BEST and ALLOW_BALLPARK controls, and warns that axis order must be handled by the operation.
official_sources.limitation: A vector conversion result must not silently become canonical geometry.

official_sources.title: GDAL Coordinate epoch support
official_sources.finding: Dynamic CRS coordinates require an epoch; GDAL can propagate and use coordinate epochs in transformations, while many formats cannot encode per-observation epoch.
official_sources.limitation: Target observation epoch remains unverified until canonical execution evidence exists.

official_sources.title: OGRSpatialReference class reference
official_sources.finding: OGRSpatialReference supports explicit data-axis to CRS-axis mappings including swaps and sign reversals.
official_sources.limitation: Axis mapping must be serialized rather than inferred from customary GIS order.

official_sources.title: GDAL Spatial Reference C++ API
official_sources.finding: OGR coordinate transformations honor authoritative axis order and data-axis mappings; a configuration switch can force traditional GIS order.
official_sources.limitation: Runtime configuration drift can change coordinate interpretation.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate-operation computation
official_sources.finding: PROJ filters and sorts candidate operations using requested accuracy, area of use and grid availability, among other criteria.
official_sources.limitation: A highest-ranked operation is not acceptable unless its required resources are actually available and pinned.

official_sources.title: projinfo
official_sources.finding: projinfo can discard coordinate operations that require missing grids or sort them by grid availability.
official_sources.limitation: Enumeration must be bound to the same PROJ database and grid set as execution.

official_sources.title: PROJ axis swap
official_sources.finding: The axisswap pipeline step explicitly reorders axes and can reverse axis direction signs.
official_sources.limitation: An explicit swap is only valid when justified by the source and target CRS axis definitions.

official_sources.title: PROJ FAQ axis ordering
official_sources.finding: PROJ follows authority-defined axis ordering, which can differ from customary GIS longitude/easting-first conventions.
official_sources.limitation: Human assumptions about X/Y ordering must not replace CRS metadata.

official_sources.title: PROJ pipeline operator
official_sources.finding: PROJ transformation pipelines are ordered sequences of coordinate operations whose full step list defines the transformation provenance.
official_sources.limitation: Every step and resource dependency must be serialized for replay.

official_sources.title: PROJ resource files and transformation grids
official_sources.finding: PROJ searches configured resource paths for transformation grids and can use network-provided resources when enabled; resource location is part of reproducibility.
official_sources.limitation: Network or local grid drift must be prevented by immutable resource provenance.
